column1: # Cutter HELD-OUT set: 100 real Tatoeba sentences cut into words, for tools/cutter_test.py --set heldout (`make cutter`).
# CUT BY CLAUDE, NOT CHECKED BY A NATIVE SPEAKER. Sentences: Tatoeba (https://tatoeba.org), CC BY 2.0 FR, each credited
# below by its sentence id and author (https://tatoeba.org/en/sentences/show/ID), from our snapshot data-2026-11-17;
# drawn at random (seed 20261118) among the sentences with an English translation, 6-18 syllables, no digits, not
# refused by tools/build_db.py tatoeba_problem(). Cut by hand on 18 Nov 2026 following docs/SEGMENTATION.md WITHOUT
# running any cutter on them first, and no cutter rule has been tuned on them afterwards: keep it so (a rule changed
# because of this file makes it a tuning set; then draw a new held-out set). The text is Tatoeba's, unchanged (typos
# such as "sẫn sàng" kept); only underscores were added.
# Format: n <TAB> Tatoeba sentence id <TAB> author <TAB> the sentence with underscores inside words
